Public IP

The address seen by ipify. VPNs, proxies and Private Relay can affect it.

PUBLIC IPv4

PUBLIC IPv6

Optional. Each check sends an HTTPS request to ipify, which sees your connection’s public address. No background polling. Subnet calculations remain on this device.

These are observations, not your PC’s local adapter addresses. A failed IPv6 check does not prove IPv6 is unavailable.
